messages:
Noah: Quick sync—ACME Health wants a 6-week POC. Need help scoping success criteria + tech blockers. Can we align on model fit (context/tooling/embeddings) and pricing assumptions?
Eva: Ack. I'm free in 20. key Qs: PHI scope? realtime latency SLO? target throughput?
Noah: PHI subset only (hashed IDs + metadata). SLO: p50 < 200ms gen for short prompts, bursts to 40 rps. Throughput: ~10k tokens/day average.
Tara: For PHI we should push Private or Dedicated. KMS + audit logs mandatory. They want canary 2-week run then ramp.
Sam: Model question: they want summarization + structured extraction + rerank across embeddings. I think 32k context helpful for long visit notes, but maybe expensive.
Eva: Agreed. Proposed model options: 1) 8k quantized + reranker for chunked notes (lower cost). 2) 32k sparse-attn variant for single-pass summaries (better UX). Add tool-calling for EMR lookup?
Priya: Security: customer will need completed security questionnaire + SOC report. Also data residency EU for some clients.
Noah: Pricing: they asked for estimate on Hosted + burst to Dedicated during tests. Any back-of-envelope?
Tara: Rough: Hosted gen cost + Dedicated reservation for baseline burst. For 32k model, billed tokens ~2.5x vs 8k. For POC we can offer a time-limited credit and show Dedicated ROI at 30% lower per-token. I'll send numbers in doc.
Eva: Eval plan (quick): 1) 50 real visit notes -> extraction accuracy (F1 target >= 0.88) 2) Latency/load test (simulate 40 rps, 95th < 400ms) 3) Rerank nDCG@10 target >= 0.9 vs baseline.
Sam: Prompt/eval detail: include edge-case prompts (abbreviations, multilingual snippets). We'll keep prompt templates and expected json schema. Example prompt: ```Extract: {patient_id, problem_list[], medications[]}```
Priya: For security questionnaire: add KMS key rotation policy, HSM mention, and runbook for data deletion. Also need to confirm logs retention window.
Noah: Blockers: EU data residency + contract SLA. Also they want tool-calling to a legacy EMR (SOAP API, OAuth). How feasible?
Tara: Tool calling ok. We'll build a small adapter (proxy) in their VPC for EMR calls. For Hosted we can use secure webhook with mutual TLS but they'd prefer Private.
Eva: Action items: - Tara: draft Dedicated vs Private tradeoff doc + cost delta (due EOD tomorrow). - Sam: produce eval prompt set + baseline reranker config (due +2 days). - Priya: start security questionnaire draft and list missing items (due EOD). - Noah: confirm list of stakeholder signoffs and timeline.
Noah: Thanks team. If we can get that doc + eval set fast, I can push a proposed SOW.
sec-bot: Automated: security-questionnaire.pdf uploaded to thread (link: https://files.redwood.example/aq/1850001234).
Sam: One more note on model fallback: implement routing policy—prefer 32k for single-shot >4k tokens else fallback to chunk+rerank. Also add KV prefix cache for repeated patient prompts.
Tara: +1. We'll also add a canary rollback if accuracy drop >5% on eval set.
Eva: I'll prototype prompt templates today and post snippets here. :rocket:
Noah: Great. I'll set a 30-min sync tomorrow 10am PT. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
